name: knowledge_ingest
purpose: Turn raw source material into structured knowledge and final outputs.

areas.raw: Unprocessed notes, copied source text, transcripts, and reference material.
areas.wiki: Clean explanations, durable facts, and cross-linked knowledge.
areas.outputs: Finished deliverables such as briefs, scripts, plans, and checklists.

steps: Preserve source facts in raw when the material is new.
Create a concise wiki version when the idea will be reused.
Create outputs only when Jay asks for an actionable deliverable.
Use stage_knowledge_file and wait for approval before writing.
output: A staged raw, wiki, or output file with a short index summary.
